combat_progression.rationale: Distinct enemy archetypes, health, movement patterns, enemy fire, scoring, collision damage, and time-based escalation are implemented and tested.
evidence: site/src/game-logic.js:40-65 defines drone, wisp, and tank enemies with different speed, health, and points.
site/src/game-logic.js:18-20 and 109-138 implement threat-level and spawn-rate escalation plus enemy projectiles.
site/test/game-logic.test.mjs and results/evidence/a2a/test.log cover collisions, scoring, escalation, damage, and game-over; all 16 tests passed.

visual_design.rationale: The desktop presentation is highly coherent and polished, with a strong neon HUD, layered canvas treatment, and clear hierarchy. Two points are withheld for the visibly clipped mobile start overlay and because the active screenshot does not visibly demonstrate enemy or impact feedback.
evidence: results/evidence/a2a/desktop-before.png and desktop-after.png show consistent cyan/pink/amber styling, framed panels, readable HUD, starfield/grid canvas, ship rendering, and leaderboard/briefing hierarchy.
site/src/game.js:178-379 implements gradients, stars, scanlines, grid, glow, enemy silhouettes, projectiles, particles, score floaters, animated thrusters, and screen shake.
results/evidence/a2a/mobile.png shows responsive stacking and touch controls, but the initial overlay is clipped at the canvas bottom before its launch button.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: Loading, empty, unconfigured, validation, and network-error states are explicit, with semantic labels, live regions, focus styling, game-over focus, and reduced-motion support.
evidence: site/src/main.js:72-151 implements loading, empty, error, validation, retry messaging, aria-busy, and aria-invalid behavior.
site/index.html:25-126 provides labeled controls, live status regions, a labeled canvas, and touch-button aria-labels.
site/src/style.css:36 and 202-204 provide visible focus treatment and prefers-reduced-motion handling.

data_security.rationale: The checked-in schema has strong RLS, least-privilege grants, column-level insert permission, server-generated fields, database constraints, and no privileged browser credential. One point is withheld because retained remote evidence proves only the valid anonymous GET/POST path; supabase/verify.sql has no execution output and no retained negative privilege or invalid-write probe.
evidence: supabase/migrations/20260805000000_create_leaderboard.sql:7-28 defines server-generated UUID/timestamp fields, name/score constraints, and deterministic ordering.

supabase/migrations/20260805000000_create_leaderboard.sql:30-64 revokes public/authenticated access, grants anon only SELECT and INSERT(player_name, score), enables RLS, and defines only anon SELECT/INSERT policies.

site/src/leaderboard.js:41-95 sends only the runtime anon key and player_name/score; results/evidence/a2a/browser-evaluator.log records anonymous REST GET 200, POST 201, and subsequent GET 200 responses.

engineering_quality.rationale: The implementation is modular, dependency-light, tested, buildable, and uses a pinned lockfile. One point is withheld for limited retained browser/rendering coverage and the documented Escape pause behavior not being wired in the source.
evidence: results/evidence/a2a/test.log records 16 passing gameplay, adapter, contract, and leaderboard tests.
results/evidence/a2a/build.log and build.exit-code show a successful static build with exit code 0.
package.json pins wrangler 4.119.0 and package-lock.json is lockfileVersion 3 with resolved integrity entries; source is separated into game, logic, audio, leaderboard, adapter, and main modules.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff includes setup/deployment documentation, source, lockfile, migration, verification SQL, source manifest, and retained build/test evidence. Two points are withheld for factual documentation mismatches: the root README names a nonexistent migration filename and claims Escape pause/resume despite no Escape handler.
evidence: README.md, site/README.md, supabase/README.md, and supabase/verify.sql document setup, deployment, security, schema application, and catalog verification.
results/evidence/a2a/source-manifest.txt, package-lock.json, build.log, test.log, and build.exit-code provide reproducibility artifacts beyond the result JSON.

README.md:33 references 20260805165000_neon_barrage_leaderboard.sql, while the checked-in root migration is 20260805000000_create_leaderboard.sql; README.md:23 claims Escape pause/resume, but site/src/main.js:197-234 maps no Escape key.

summary: Manual evidence award: 39/46. The candidate has strong tested gameplay, visual direction, resilience, and database design; deductions reflect the clipped mobile launch overlay, incomplete retained remote security evidence, and handoff/documentation mismatches.
